_readme: Reply copy. Auto-sent mail is ONLY ever built from these approved templates, never free-generated. Variables: {first} {startup} {late} {followup} {wait} {delay_line} {receipt_line} {aged_line} {feature} {referral_link}. All copy here is placeholder wording for Jumpstart's ops lead to confirm; facts marked 'assumed' in kb must be checked before go-live. {sorry} expands to "I'm sorry " or, when the reply is late, "I'm sorry for the slow reply, and sorry ".

templates.chase_first:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for getting in touch. We've asked {startup} for an update on your interview and added you to the list we send them each morning. We'll email you as soon as we hear anything, and if there's nothing by {followup} we'll chase again and let you know either way.
templates.chase_repeat:
Hi {first},

{sorry}you've had to ask more than once. We've chased {startup} again and flagged that you've been waiting {wait}. We'll update you by {followup}, even if the update is that we're still waiting.
templates.app_status:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for checking in. {receipt_line}Your application is with our team and we review them in the order they arrive, so there's nothing else you need to do. We'll email you as soon as it's been looked at.{aged_line}
templates.feedback_ack:
Hi {first},

{sorry}it didn't work out with {startup}. We've asked them for feedback on your application. Not every startup shares it, but we'll pass on anything we get, and we'll be in touch by {followup} either way.
templates.rejection_ack:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for letting us know, and sorry it wasn't the outcome you wanted. We've noted the decision{delay_line}. Your profile stays active so you'll keep getting matches, and if you'd like feedback just reply and we'll ask {startup}.
templates.unsub_ack:
Hi,

Done, you won't get any more Jumpstart marketing emails. If you have a live application or interview we may still email you about that; just reply if you'd like those stopped too.
templates.deletion_ack:
Hi {first},

{late}We've received your request to delete your account and data, and we've stopped all emails to you as of now. We'll verify the request and complete the deletion within 30 days, then confirm by email. Reply here if anything changes.
templates.placement:
Hi {first},

Congratulations, that's brilliant news. We've updated your profile and we're delighted for you. If a friend would benefit from Jumpstart, we'd love an introduction: {referral_link}
templates.video_incident:
Hi {first},

{late}Sorry about the trouble uploading your video. It's a known problem on our side, not something you've done, and our engineers are fixing it. Compressing the file before uploading has worked for some people, and we'll email you as soon as uploads are working again.
templates.apply_button:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for flagging the apply button problem on mobile. We've logged it with our engineers. In the meantime, applying from a desktop browser should work. We'll let you know once it's fixed.
templates.product_ack:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks, that detail is really useful. I've passed your request for {feature} to our product team, and we'll keep you updated. {extra}
templates.change_email:
Hi {first},

{late}To keep accounts secure we don't change a login email from an email request alone. We've sent a verification link to your current address. Click it, then enter your new address and we'll switch it straight away. If you can't reach your current address, reply here and we'll verify you another way.
templates.login_help:
Hi {first},

{sorry}about the login trouble. We've sent a fresh sign-in link to your registered email; links expire after a short time, so use it soon. If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check spam and reply here so we can look at delivery.
templates.pause:
Hi {first},

{late}Done: we've paused your profile, so you won't be matched or emailed about new roles until you resume. Reply "resume" whenever you're ready.
templates.referral:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks, we'd love that. Your friend can join through your personal link: {referral_link}
templates.product_ack_zero:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for letting us know. We're checking that your profile is visible and set up for matching, and we'll email you only if something needs fixing. I've also passed your feedback to our product team.
templates.thanks_close:
Hi {first},

Glad that helped, and good luck with everything.
templates.resolved_close:
Hi {first},

Great, glad it's working now. If it happens again, just reply to this email.
templates.vendor_close:
Hi {first},

Thanks for getting in touch. I've passed this to our partnerships team, and they'll reply if it's a fit.
templates.watch_hold:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for chasing, and I'm sorry you're still waiting. We've raised your application with {startup} directly and our team is following it up. We'll email you as soon as we know more, and by {followup} at the latest.
templates.rebook:
Hi {first},

{sorry}about the interview. Nothing about this counts against you. You can pick a new time here: {rebooking_link}. We've also let {startup} know and recorded it on our side.
templates.sar_ack:
Hi {first},

Thanks, we've received your request for a copy of your personal data. We'll send it to this email address by {sar_due}, which is within the one-month legal deadline. You don't need to do anything else.
templates.rtw_ack:
Hi {first},

Thanks for checking first. Please don't email identity or right-to-work documents to us or anyone else. {startup} will check your right to work directly as part of their hiring process. If we ever need a document, we'll send you a secure upload link: {secure_upload_link}.
templates.adjustment:
Hi {first},

Thanks for telling us. {application_alternative} If anything else would make the process easier, reply and tell us what helps.
templates.visa_answer:
Hi {first},

{late}{visa_filter} Startups on Jumpstart that sponsor Skilled Worker visas: {sponsors}. We can't give immigration advice, but these listings will say so where sponsorship is offered.
templates.salary_answer:
Hi {first},

{late}You don't have to share your current salary. A good answer is a range based on the role. For context, {startup} has told us the range for this kind of role is {salary_range}. Aim for the part of that range that reflects your experience.
templates.salary_general:
Hi {first},

{late}You don't have to share your current salary, and it's fine to say you'd rather talk about the range for this role. If you give a figure, make it a range based on the role, not your current pay.
templates.reference_answer:
Hi {first},

{late}That's more common than you'd think. Most startups are flexible on references: a previous colleague, a client or a manager from another role usually works. It's fine to say briefly, without blame, that the role ended in redundancy.
templates.responses_answer:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for being straight with us. Startups do review every application, but response rates vary a lot between them. We've checked your profile is visible and complete, and we'll point you towards startups that reply quickly.
templates.listing_answer:
Hi {first},

{sorry}for the confusion. You didn't do anything wrong. A role disappears from your dashboard when a startup hides its listing, which is what happened here. Your application is still with {startup}.
templates.video_check_answer:
Hi {first},

Thanks for checking. We're confirming whether your video saved, and we'll email you today either way. If it didn't, you'll be able to re-upload it once the current upload issue is fixed.
templates.critical_ack:
Hi {first},

Thanks for telling us. This has gone straight to a senior member of our team, who will reply to you personally today.
templates.wellbeing_ack:
Hi {first},

Thank you for telling us, and I'm sorry things are this hard. A member of our team will reply to you personally today. If you need to talk to someone right now, Samaritans are free and open 24 hours on 116 123.
templates.watch_hold_frustrated:
Hi {first},

You're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry. You shouldn't have had to chase us like this. I've escalated your application with {startup} today and asked for a clear answer either way. You'll hear from us by {followup} at the latest, even if the answer is that they haven't decided.
templates.chase_frustrated:
Hi {first},

You're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry you've had to keep asking. I've escalated this with {startup} today as a priority and asked for a yes or no. You'll hear from us by {followup} at the latest, whatever the answer.
templates.video_frustrated:
Hi {first},

I'm sorry. You've written several times and should have heard back much sooner. The video upload problem is a known fault affecting several candidates and our engineers are fixing it. Your profile is still live and visible to startups without the video, and we'll email you the moment uploads work again.
templates.status_update: [Built in engine/act.py] Hi {first}, Thanks for checking in. Here's where you are with {startup}: <stage line>. <startup's usual timeline, from the startup bank, if known>. We've asked {startup} for an update on your <round> and we'll be in touch by {followup}.
templates.status_update_known: [Built in engine/act.py] Hi {first}, Thanks for checking in. Here's where you are with {startup}: <stage line>. Good news: {startup} told us on <date> that <update on file>. We'll keep an eye on it and let you know as soon as we hear more.
templates.status_update_repeat: [Built in engine/act.py] As status_update, opening: Thanks for following up, and I'm sorry you've had to ask again. Ends: whatever the answer.
templates.status_update_frustrated: [Built in engine/act.py] As status_update, opening: You're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry you've had to keep asking. Ends: whatever the answer.
templates.status_update_watch: [Built in engine/act.py] For startups flagged to their account owner. Opening: Thanks for checking in, and I'm sorry you're still waiting. No timeline line.
templates.status_update_watch_frustrated: [Built in engine/act.py] As status_update_watch, opening: You're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry you've had to keep asking.

draft_templates.salary_draft:
Hi {first},

{late}Good question. You're not obliged to share your current salary, and it's reasonable to say you'd rather focus on the range for this role and what you're looking for. If you do give a figure, give a range based on the role, not your current pay. Happy to talk it through on a call if useful.
draft_templates.reference_draft:
Hi {first},

{late}That's a tricky one, and you're not alone. Most startups are flexible on who counts as a reference: a previous colleague, a client or a manager from another role can work well. It's fine to explain briefly and without blame that the circumstances were a redundancy. Want us to ask {startup} what they would accept?
draft_templates.stream_draft:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for asking. Our team will look at your profile and confirm which stream or streams fit best, and we'll email you by {followup}.
draft_templates.visa_draft:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for asking. We can't give immigration advice, but we can tell you which startups on Jumpstart have said they sponsor visas, and we've noted that you'd find a sponsorship filter useful. We'll send you a list by {followup}.
draft_templates.negative_draft:
Hi {first},

{late}Thank you for being straight with us, and I'm sorry that's been your experience. I'd like to look at what's happened to your applications and where they are. Could we have a short call this week?
draft_templates.bug_draft:
Hi {first},

{late}Thanks for flagging this. We've logged it with our engineers and will update you by {followup}.
draft_templates.listing_draft:
Hi {first},

{sorry}for the confusion. This isn't something you did. A role can disappear from your dashboard when a startup hides its listing, and that is what we think happened here. We're checking with {startup} now and will confirm where things stand.
draft_templates.video_check_draft:
Hi {first},

{sorry}about the uncertainty. We're checking whether your video saved properly and will confirm today. If it didn't, we'll tell you how to re-send it once the upload issue is fixed.

kb._status: assumed: confirm all wording with Jumpstart before go-live

howto.headline: You can change your headline under Profile > Edit profile. Update the headline field and save.
howto.photo: You can change your profile photo under Profile > Edit profile. Upload a new image and save.
howto.cv: You can upload a new CV under Profile > Documents. The new version replaces the old one straight away.
howto.linkedin: You can fix your LinkedIn link under Profile > Edit profile > Links. If you paste the correct URL in a reply, we'll update it for you.
howto.phone: Yes, you can add a phone number under Profile > Edit profile > Contact details.
howto.language: You can add a second language under Profile > Edit profile > Languages.
howto.font: The CV preview font is fixed so every candidate looks consistent to startups, but we've passed your preference to the product team.
howto.name: You can correct your name under Profile > Edit profile. If it won't save, reply with the correct spelling and we'll fix it for you.
howto.general: You can change this under Profile > Edit profile. If it doesn't save, reply and we'll do it for you.

faq.pricing: Jumpstart is free for candidates. Startups pay us when they make a hire.
faq.matching: Matching uses your stream, profile and preferences. New matches arrive in your weekly roles email and in your dashboard.
faq.email_timing: The weekly roles email goes out once a week at a fixed time, and new matches also appear in your dashboard as soon as they're found.
faq.events: We run events through the year. Dates are on our events page and in the weekly newsletter.
faq.age: There's no age limit for joining.
faq.right_to_work: Most roles are with UK startups, so you'll need the right to work in the UK. Some startups sponsor visas, and listings say so where they do.
faq.relocation: You can join before you move. Tell startups your expected start date and location in your profile.
faq.multiple_roles: Yes, you can apply for more than one role, including at the same startup. Pick the one you want most as your priority.
faq.video_compulsory: The intro video is optional, but startups tell us it helps them get a feel for you.
faq.video_professional: It doesn't need to be polished. A phone camera and good light is plenty; startups want to hear you, not see production.
faq.video_phone: Yes, you can record and upload from your phone.
faq.video_rerecord: Yes, you can re-record as many times as you like; the latest version is the one startups see.
faq.video_topics: Cover who you are, what you've done, and what you want next, in that order.
faq.video_order: Startups see your profile as a whole, so the video and CV sit side by side.
faq.general: Thanks for the question. Matching, roles and your profile are covered in our candidate FAQ, and if it isn't answered there just reply and we'll help.

prep.first_interview: For a first interview: research the startup's product and customers, have two or three concrete examples of work you've done, and prepare questions about what the role will own in its first 90 days.
prep.final_interview: For a final with a founder or CEO: be ready to talk about why this company and why now, how you'd approach your first 30 days, and any concerns you want to raise. Ask what success looks like in the first six months.
prep.thank_you: Yes, a short thank-you note within 24 hours is a good idea. Two or three lines, one specific thing you enjoyed, and why you're keen.
prep.what_to_wear: Smart casual is fine for most startups. If you're unsure, ask the startup or go one notch smarter than their website photos.
prep.how_many: It varies by startup. Most tell you the process in the listing or at the first call, and it's always fine to ask what the stages are.
prep.case_study: For a take-home case study: ask how long they expect it to take and stick to that, state your assumptions clearly, and keep the format simple.
prep.references: It's common for startups to ask for two references before a final round. Give people who know your work and let them know to expect the call.
prep.general: Thanks for asking. Reply with the startup and the round you're preparing for and we'll tailor some tips.
